description: Colour palettes for chart and dashboard rendering. Every palette is colour-blind safe for the first four series and remains distinguishable in grayscale for the first two.
rules: Bars and columns start at zero; a truncated bar axis is a defect, not a style choice.
Never encode meaning with colour alone: pair colour with a label, pattern or direct value.
Cap legends at six entries; group the tail into 'Other'.
Light backgrounds only for text-bearing fills; keep contrast at or above 4.5:1.
Grayscale palette exists so printed and photocopied output stays readable.
